definition: Eduard Hovy is a Research Professor in the Language Technologies Institute at Carnegie Mellon University.
details: He is one of the original 17 Fellows of the Association for Computational Linguistics.
story: Imagine learning a language by reading every book in the library and noticing, over time, which words travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It is fluency built from pattern, not from memorized rules. And that is Eduard Hovy — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
